create_encasedplus.ponder.gearbox.text_1: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
create_encasedplus.ponder.gearbox.text_2: A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
create_encasedplus.ponder.gearbox.text_3: Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_mix: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_pre: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
When items are provided on a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically
Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
create_encasedplus.ponder.creative_cogwh: Generating Rotational Force using Creative Cogwheels
Creative Cogwheels are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
The generated speed can be configured on its input panels
create_encasedplus.ponder.depot.text_1: Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements
create_encasedplus.ponder.depot.text_2: Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it
create_encasedplus.ponder.depot.text_3: Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing
create_encasedplus.ponder.depot.text_4: ...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms
create_encasedplus.ponder.chain_drive.he: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
create_encasedplus.ponder.chain_drive.te: Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row
All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction
Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees
create_encasedplus.ponder.chain_gearshif: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives
When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled
Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead
In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift
Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2
create_encasedplus.ponder.configurable_g: Gearboxes are useful to change the direction of a shaft
But they are very annoying when you want to send the rotation in multiple axis
The configurable gearbox is here to fix this problem
You can add a shaft to this gearbox by right clicking on a face with a shaft
You can add a shaft to this gearbox by right clicking on a face with a wrench
You can also remove a shaft on a face by right clicking with a wrench
create_encasedplus.ponder.shared.storage: Inventories attached to the Contraption will pick up their drops automatically
create_encasedplus.ponder.chain_conveyor: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them
Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..
..and connect to shafts above or below them
Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain
At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it
create_encasedplus.ponder.clutch.header: Controlling rotational force using a Clutch
create_encasedplus.ponder.clutch.text_1: Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
create_encasedplus.ponder.clutch.text_2: When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection
create_encasedplus.ponder.gearshift.head: Controlling rotational force using a Gearshift
create_encasedplus.ponder.gearshift.text: Gearshifts will relay rotation in a straight line
When powered by Redstone, it reverses the transmission
create_encasedplus.ponder.deployer.text_: Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions
Right-click the front to give it an Item to use
Items can also be inserted automatically
When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item
Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...
...and only non-matching items will be extracted
It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself
Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it
create_encasedplus.ponder.deployer_contr: Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption
The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull
create_encasedplus.ponder.deployer_modes: By default, a Deployer imitates a Right-click interaction
Using a Wrench, it can be set to imitate a Left-click instead
create_encasedplus.ponder.deployer_proce: With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer
When items are provided on a belt...
The Deployer will hold and process them automatically
create_encasedplus.ponder.deployer_redst: When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate
Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles
Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
create_encasedplus.ponder.portable_stora: Moving inventories can be tricky to access with automation.
This component can interact with storage without the need to stop the contraption.
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks in between
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL inventories on the contraption
After no items have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging
Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input
create_encasedplus.ponder.fan_processing: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
Items caught in the area will be smelted
Food items thrown here would be incinerated
Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
Some interesting new processing can be done with it
The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_dri: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it
Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input
Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_har: Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_saw: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground
Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into
Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_rol: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks
Clearing and Paving with the Roller
Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions
create_encasedplus.ponder.mechanical_plo: Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox
...they can also launch entities without hurting them
create_encasedplus.ponder.auto_clutch.te: Automatic Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
It breaks the connection when a condition is fulfilled
Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
create_encasedplus.ponder.slicer.text_1: Right-click it with a valid tool
create_encasedplus.ponder.slicer.text_2: The slicer can also operate on a basin
